answer: A marble of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vertex of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a concise bullet points, data-driven conclusions register, it stays short. The design leans on verifiable random functions for fair selection. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
